mapper.sql: achievement_id as "achievementId", faculty_user_id as "facultyUserId", evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", academic_year as "academicYear", semester, course_code as "courseCode", course_name as "courseName", course_type as "courseType", credit_hours as "creditHours", achievement_status as "achievementStatus", management_item_setting_id as "managementItemSettingId", dynamic_fields::text as "dynamicFieldsJson", attachment_refs::text as "attachmentRefsJson", created_at as "createdAt", created_by as "createdBy", updated_at as "updatedAt", updated_by as "updatedBy"
mapper.select: select from teaching_achievements order by updated_at desc, achievement_id desc limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.safePage} * #{criteria.safeSize}
select from teaching_achievements where achievement_id = #{achievementId} and faculty_user_id = #{facultyUserId} and deleted_yn = 'N'
select from teaching_achievements where faculty_user_id = #{facultyUserId} and academic_year = #{academicYear} and semester = #{semester} and course_code = #{courseCode} and deleted_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: insert into teaching_achievements (faculty_user_id, evaluation_year, academic_year, semester, course_code, course_name, course_type, credit_hours, achievement_status, management_item_setting_id, dynamic_fields, attachment_refs, created_by, updated_by) values (#{facultyUserId}, #{request.evaluationYear}, #{request.academicYear}, #{request.semester}, #{request.courseCode}, #{request.courseName}, #{request.courseType}, #{request.creditHours}, 'DRAFTING', #{request.managementItemSettingId}, cast(#{dynamicFieldsJson} as jsonb), cast(#{attachmentRefsJson} as jsonb), #{facultyUserId}, #{facultyUserId})
mapper.update: update teaching_achievements set evaluation_year = #{request.evaluationYear}, academic_year = #{request.academicYear}, semester = #{request.semester}, course_code = #{request.courseCode}, course_name = #{request.courseName}, course_type = #{request.courseType}, credit_hours = #{request.creditHours}, management_item_setting_id = #{request.managementItemSettingId}, dynamic_fields = cast(#{dynamicFieldsJson} as jsonb), attachment_refs = cast(#{attachmentRefsJson} as jsonb), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{facultyUserId} where achievement_id = #{request.achievementId} and faculty_user_id = #{facultyUserId} and deleted_yn = 'N' and achievement_status <> 'EVALUATION_CONFIRMED'
